details: The only interaction path is click-to-zoom using a custom d3.interpolateZoom tween, so no brush/drag update storms or cross-view dispatch loops exist; pointer events unify mouse/touch cleanly. However, zoomTo() never calls .interrupt() on svg or circles before launching a new transition, so rapid clicks mid-animation rely solely on D3's implicit same-element transition replacement rather than explicit interruption, risking a brief snap if the end handler (which finalises view) fires out of order.
